# TestScript for 13-twelve-factor-precedence
# Asserts 4-tier configuration precedence: CLI Flag > Environment Variable > Config File > Struct Default,
# env:"-" exclusion, and config:"-" rejection

env HOME=$WORK/home
env XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$WORK/xdg

# 1. Tier 4: struct defaults
exec server-precedence
stdout '⚙  server-precedence'
stdout '-p, --port\s+int\s+8080\s+· default'
stdout '--host\s+string\s+127\.0\.0\.1\s+· default'
stdout '-e, --environment\s+string\s+dev\s+· default'
stdout '-d, --debug\s+bool\s+false\s+· default'
stdout '--worker-id\s+string\s+—\s+○ unset'
! stdout '--session-id'

# 2. Tier 3: config file overrides defaults
exec server-precedence -c server.toml
stdout '-c, --config-file\s+conga\.ConfigFile\s+server\.toml\s+● cli --config-file'
stdout '-p, --port\s+int\s+9001\s+● config port'
stdout '--host\s+string\s+10\.0\.0\.1\s+● config host'
stdout '-e, --environment\s+string\s+staging\s+● config environment'
stdout '-d, --debug\s+bool\s+true\s+● config debug'
stdout '--worker-id\s+string\s+w-file\s+● config worker-id'

# 3. --why displays non-sensitive flag values tagged safe:"true"
exec server-precedence -c server.toml --why
stdout '--port\s+9001\s+config\s+PORT\s+port'
! stdout '██████'

# 4. Tier 2: environment variable overrides config file
# (--port declares env:"PORT" verbatim; the SERVER_ prefix only applies to flags without an env tag)
env PORT=9002
exec server-precedence -c server.toml
stdout '-p, --port\s+int\s+9002\s+● env PORT'
stdout '--host\s+string\s+10\.0\.0\.1\s+● config host'

# 5. Tier 1: CLI flag overrides environment variable and config file
exec server-precedence -c server.toml -p 9003
stdout '-p, --port\s+int\s+9003\s+● cli --port'
stdout '--host\s+string\s+10\.0\.0\.1\s+● config host'

# 6. --why indicates the loaded decoders, the missing built-in tier, and how
#    to create a config file the application will see
exec server-precedence --why
stdout 'Config decoders: \.toml'
stdout 'xdg[/\\]server-precedence\s+directory does not exist'
stdout 'looked for: .*xdg[/\\]server-precedence\.toml'
stdout 'Create a configuration file at one of:'
stdout 'xdg[/\\]server-precedence[/\\]config\.toml'

# 7. Built-in conventional tier: ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-~/.config}/<app-name>/config.toml
#    (seeded here so the earlier scenarios prove the pure 4-tier ladder without it)
env PORT=
mkdir xdg/server-precedence
cp xdg-config.toml xdg/server-precedence/config.toml
exec server-precedence
stdout '-c, --config-file\s+conga\.ConfigFile\s+.*xdg[/\\]server-precedence[/\\]config\.toml\s+● config .*xdg[/\\]server-precedence[/\\]config\.toml'
stdout '-p, --port\s+int\s+7001\s+● config port'
stdout '--host\s+string\s+127\.0\.0\.1\s+· default'

# 8. --why lists the built-in conventional tier with the loaded outcome
#    (loaded tiers carry no probed-file list and no creation examples)
exec server-precedence --why
stdout 'Config decoders: \.toml'
stdout 'xdg[/\\]server-precedence\s+loaded: .*xdg[/\\]server-precedence[/\\]config\.toml'
! stdout 'looked for:'
! stdout 'Create a configuration file'

# 9. Config file path selected via SERVER_CONFIG environment variable
env SERVER_CONFIG=server.toml
exec server-precedence
stdout '-c, --config-file\s+conga\.ConfigFile\s+server\.toml\s+● env SERVER_CONFIG'
stdout '-p, --port\s+int\s+9001\s+● config port'
env SERVER_CONFIG=

# 10. env:"-" disables environment binding entirely: neither the verbatim
#     TRACE name nor the prefix-derived SERVER_TRACE name reaches the flag
env SERVER_TRACE=true
env TRACE=true
exec server-precedence
stdout '--trace\s+bool\s+false\s+○ unset'
stdout '--worker-id\s+string\s+—\s+○ unset'

# 11. The same flag still binds through the CLI
exec server-precedence --trace
stdout '--trace\s+bool\s+true\s+● cli --trace'
env SERVER_TRACE=
env TRACE=

# 12. Missing explicit config file fails with a clean error (config-read
#     failures classify as runtime errors: exit 1, not usage exit 2)
exit-status 1 server-precedence -c nonexistent.toml
stderr 'cannot read config file "nonexistent\.toml"'

# 13. Field tagged config:"-" is rejected inside config files
exit-status 1 server-precedence -c excluded.toml
stderr 'field "auth_token" is excluded from config files'

# 14. Placeholder renders in help output
exec server-precedence --help
stdout '-p, --port=PORT\s+Server port'
stdout '--auth-token=STRING\s+Bearer token'

-- server.toml --
port = 9001
host = "10.0.0.1"
environment = "staging"
debug = true
worker-id = "w-file"

-- excluded.toml --
port = 9001
auth_token = "hunter2"

-- xdg-config.toml --
port = 7001
